_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Keyboard focus follows a pick made with the pointer. The screen is 1280x800 (desktop layout, where the search has focus from the start). The server offers a second model, "Predictable Twin". To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". 1. Navigate to /new and open the model picker. 2. The option ".p-select-option" containing "Predictable Twin" ("the twin") should be visible, and the panel's searchbox (role "searchbox") should be document.activeElement. 3. Press ArrowDown, then ArrowUp. 4. The panel's ".p-select-option.p-focus" must not contain "Twin". 5. Click the twin: it should get the class "p-focus". 6. Press Enter: the panel should be hidden, and the picker's ".model-picker-value-name" should have exactly the text "Predictable Twin".
